subject.title: perf(gateway): warm handler families and cache identity avatars

question: Should maintainers accept the added dashboard prewarm and stale-while-revalidate behavior after current-base and real-latency proof are supplied?
rationale: The branch spans gateway startup, protocol, task execution boundaries, Control UI callers, and authentication-status presentation; the protected maintainer label means automation should not make the final acceptance decision.

options.title: Request current-base proof
options.body: Rebase the branch, verify the protocol/client and startup paths on the merge result, and attach redacted before/after gateway latency output.

options.title: Accept measured tradeoff
options.body: Land after maintainer review if the intended post-ready import work and temporarily stale usage display are acceptable operational tradeoffs.

options.title: Narrow the PR
options.body: Split the changes if maintainers want independent review of startup prewarming, avatar caching, cron payload work, and auth-status caching.

recommendation.title: Request current-base proof
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch, verify the protocol/client and startup paths on the merge result, and attach redacted before/after gateway latency output.
